description.value: Ellison sits on the northeastern shore of Okanagan Lake with rocky headlands, sheltered coves, and three warm-water beaches — plus western Canada's only freshwater dive park. Full-amenity provincial park reached by paved road from Vernon; open spring through fall and busy in peak summer.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms Ellison Park is an active provincial campground on the northeastern shore of Okanagan Lake with frontcountry camping. The 'Book camping' feature and the frontcountry reservations page confirm reservations are accepted. OSM internet_access=no is corroborated by the website noting 'most parks lack internet connectivity'; no other amenities (showers, potable water, etc.) are explicitly mentioned in the fetched content, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM phone (+1-250-548-0076) and email (info@campokanagan.com) appear to belong to the park operator Kaloya Contracting Ltd., not BC Parks directly; the website does not list or corroborate this phone number, so it cannot be confirmed.
OSM name is 'Ellison Provincial Campground' but the BC Parks website consistently uses 'Ellison Park' — minor discrepancy worth noting.
No address is present in the OSM record; only directional driving instructions are provided on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active BC provincial campground in the Okanagan with confirmed reservations and 71 sites; a legitimate and useful listing for touring cyclists riding the Okanagan Lake corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: The operator contact email (info@campokanagan.com) and phone may be useful for cyclist-specific inquiries (e.g., late arrivals), but general reservations should go through the BC Parks booking system.

wow_evidence: three warm-water beaches… western Canada's only freshwater dive park
